title: S3 bucket allows public read access
description: Block Public Access is disabled and the bucket policy grants s3:GetObject to everyone.

title: Root account has no multi-factor authentication
description: The account root user can sign in with a password alone.

title: Security group exposes SSH to the internet
description: Inbound TCP 22 is open to 0.0.0.0/0 on a security group attached to a production web server.

title: CloudTrail is not enabled in all regions
description: The trail records only one region, so activity elsewhere would not be logged.

title: IAM access key not rotated in over 90 days
description: The access key is 214 days old and has been used recently.
